items.exampleEn: Firearms are not allowed inside the stadium.
items.exampleZh: 體育場內禁止攜帶槍枝。

items.exampleEn: The film shows the dictator's last days in power.
items.exampleZh: 那部電影呈現獨裁者掌權的最後幾天。

items.exampleEn: In the dark cave, we lit a torch to see the walls.
items.exampleZh: 在漆黑的洞穴裡，我們點了一支火把來看清洞壁。

items.exampleEn: The children dressed up as pirates for the party.
items.exampleZh: 孩子們打扮成海盜去參加派對。

items.exampleEn: The government plans to abolish the tax on books next year.
items.exampleZh: 政府計畫明年廢除書籍的稅。

items.exampleEn: The band played a patriotic song at the opening of the games.
items.exampleZh: 樂隊在運動會開幕時演奏了一首愛國歌曲。

items.exampleEn: The first conquest of Mount Everest took place in 1953.
items.exampleZh: 人類首次征服聖母峰是在 1953 年。

items.exampleEn: The writer talks about the repression of her feelings as a child.
items.exampleZh: 那位作家談到她小時候如何壓抑自己的情緒。

items.sentenceEn: This picture book is about a pirate who is afraid of water.
items.sentenceZh: 這本繪本講的是一個怕水的海盜。

items.audioEn: The town abolished the parking fee on Sundays, so you can park for free all day.
items.audioZh: 鎮上廢除了星期日的停車費，所以整天都可以免費停車。
items.questionZh: 星期日的停車規定有什麼改變？
options: The fee is higher on Sundays
You can park for one hour

items.sentenceEn: When the lights went out, we used a torch to find our way down the stairs.
items.sentenceZh: 停電時，我們用手電筒找路下樓梯。

items.sentenceEn: Some old songs make people feel patriotic and proud of their home.
items.sentenceZh: 有些老歌讓人感到愛國，並以自己的家鄉為榮。

items.stemEn: The ____ sailed from island to island, stealing gold from other ships.
items.stemZh: 海盜們從一座島航行到另一座島，搶奪其他船上的黃金。

items.stemEn: The club voted to ____ the rule that members must wear ties.
items.stemZh: 社團投票廢除了會員必須打領帶的規定。

items.passageEn: On the radio this morning, a historian talked about the history of our harbor. First, she described how pirates once attacked trading ships near the coast, and how sailors used firearms to defend themselves. Then she covered a darker period, when a dictator ruled the region and many people lived under repression until his regime finally fell. She ended on a happy note: the torch that was carried through the city when the new harbor opened in 1960 is still kept in the city hall.
items.passageZh: 今天早上的廣播節目裡，一位歷史學家談到我們港口的歷史。她先說到以前海盜怎麼在海岸附近攻擊商船，以及水手怎麼用槍枝自衛。接著她講到一段較黑暗的時期：一位獨裁者統治這個地區，許多人生活在壓迫之下，直到他的政權終於結束。她最後以愉快的話題作結：1960 年新港口啟用時在城裡傳遞的火炬，至今仍收藏在市政廳。

questions.questionZh: 歷史學家一開始講了什麼？
1960 年傳遞的火炬現在放在哪裡？

items.promptZh: 這本書描寫羅馬人征服不列顛的經過。
referenceEn: This book describes the Roman conquest of Britain.
This book tells the story of the Roman conquest of Britain.
rubricZh: 要用 conquest 當名詞（例如 the Roman conquest of Britain）
「描寫」可寫，例如 describe、tell the story of 等

items.instructionZh: 用 pirate 造一個句子，說說你看過或讀過的關於海盜的電影、書或遊戲。
referenceEn: I watched a funny movie about a pirate who lost his ship.
When I was young, I loved reading stories about pirates.
rubricZh: 句子要用到 pirate（例如 a pirate、pirates）
時態配合內容（例如 watched、loved 等）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第③關 A：FIX 7：與 l02「港邊海軍博物館」事件重複，改成電台節目；第②關：和平條約結束獨裁不合邏輯，改 regime fell
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改前："This summer, the city museum is holding an exhibition about the history of our harbor. The first room tells how pirates once attacked trading ships near the coast, and visitors can see the old firearms that sailors used to defend themselves. The second room covers a darker period, when a dictator ruled the region and many people lived under repression until a peace treaty was signed. The last room is the most cheerful: it shows the torch that was carried through the city when the new harbor opened in 1960."；改後："On the radio this morning, a historian talked about the history of our harbor. First, she described how pirates once attacked trading ships near the coast, and how sailors used firearms to defend themselves. Then she covered a darker period, when a dictator ruled the region and many people lived under repression until his regime finally fell. She ended on a happy note: the torch that was carried through the city when the new harbor opened in 1960 is still kept in the city hall."

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第③關 A：FIX 7：中譯同步
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改前："今年夏天，市立博物館舉辦一場關於我們港口歷史的展覽。第一個展間介紹海盜以前如何在海岸附近攻擊商船，參觀者可以看到水手們當年用來自衛的舊槍枝。第二個展間講述一段較黑暗的時期：一位獨裁者統治這個地區，許多人生活在壓迫之下，直到和平條約簽訂為止。最後一個展間最令人愉快：展出 1960 年新港口啟用時在城裡傳遞的火炬。"；改後："今天早上的廣播節目裡，一位歷史學家談到我們港口的歷史。她先說到以前海盜怎麼在海岸附近攻擊商船，以及水手怎麼用槍枝自衛。接著她講到一段較黑暗的時期：一位獨裁者統治這個地區，許多人生活在壓迫之下，直到他的政權終於垮台。她最後以愉快的話題作結：1960 年新港口啟用時在城裡傳遞的火炬，至今仍保存在市政廳。"

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 第②關 issue 結案：「a dictator ruled the region and many people lived under repression until a peace treaty was signed」邏輯不通：和平條約結束的是戰爭，不是獨裁統治；且短文出現獨裁與鎮壓，與作者自述「沉重字不進閱讀短文」不一致。建議改為 until the dictator lost power 之類，或此段改中性內容。
